items.headline: Anthropic shares slump on second day after record IPO
items.summary: Anthropic stock fell premarket as the broader AI trade faltered, with Nvidia, AMD and megacap tech also declining. The drop signals investor caution about AI valuations despite the company's record-breaking $107 billion offering haul.

items.headline: China's AI ambitions run into a funding problem
items.summary: Chinese AI start-ups face soaring model-training costs but struggle to match the tens of billions raised by US rivals like Anthropic. The capital gap threatens China's position in the US-China race for AI supremacy.

items.headline: AI trade falters as Anthropic points lower
items.summary: After Anthropic's IPO success, markets returned to worrying about the sustainability of the AI trade, dragging down tech futures. The pullback reflects mounting concern over how AI buildouts are being financed.

items.headline: How AI is reshaping entry-level science careers
items.summary: Nature examines how automation of coding and basic scientific tasks threatens roles for graduate students, postdocs and technicians. The shift raises urgent questions about skills and job security for early-career researchers.

items.headline: AI 'slop' intensifies existing junk culture at scale
items.summary: The NYT Magazine argues AI didn't invent low-quality content but reproduces addictive junk culture inexpensively and at near-infinite scale. It also notes OpenAI shut down its Sora video-generating model earlier this year.

items.headline: Anthropic pulls off biggest IPO ever, investors want more
items.summary: Anthropic raised about $120 billion and reached a market value near $1.27 trillion, yet shares fell about 9% premarket. The muted reception signals significant hurdles remain for the broader AI industry.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO: four ways it wants to disrupt science
items.summary: Anthropic aims to cure diseases, accelerate discovery and automate science, but many researchers are skeptical of its lofty ambitions. The debut marks a milestone moment for AI in research fields.

items.headline: Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development at IPO
items.summary: At the Nasdaq opening bell, Dario Amodei vowed Anthropic would not bend to business or political pressure and would keep AI under human control. The pledge came as the company made its record-setting Wall Street debut.

items.headline: Anthropic prices largest IPO in history at $83 a share
items.summary: Anthropic sold more than 980 million shares for $81.3 billion, plus $26 billion in a private placement, for a $107 billion total haul. The offering topped SpaceX's June raise to become the largest in history.

items.headline: AI models ditch hallucinated references and other bad habits
items.summary: Nature reports AI systems are increasingly abandoning fabricated citations, improving reliability for research use. The progress addresses a longstanding criticism of generative AI tools in science.

items.headline: Anthropic faced regulatory, anti-AI headwinds entering IPO
items.summary: Anthropic barreled ahead with its debut despite market volatility, a potential Democratic-led regulatory crackdown and growing anti-AI public sentiment. Its prospectus notably describes AI as posing 'catastrophic or existential' danger.

items.headline: Jensen Huang's $500 billion AI funding deal evaporates
items.summary: A much-touted $500 billion funding arrangement linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang failed to materialize, raising fears about neocloud financing. Apollo's chief warned capital for many neoclouds is set to disappear.

items.headline: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon from Google DeepMind
items.summary: Google began rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across software engineering, knowledge work and science. It joins the expanding Gemini 4 family of frontier models.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO plans show OpenAI's 2027 debut on track
items.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar said the company's IPO remains on track for 2027, citing 70% Q3 revenue growth and a doubling of enterprise sales. OpenAI's latest round values it at roughly $1.25 trillion.

items.headline: AI captured 86% of US venture dollars in H1 2026
items.summary: AI startups absorbed $355.9 billion, or 86% of US venture funding in the first half of 2026, tying thousands of smaller suppliers to the giants' IPO performance. The concentration raises systemic risk concerns across the ecosystem.

items.headline: Anthropic faces longer wait than SpaceX to join indexes
items.summary: Anthropic could join the Russell 1000 after Dec. 11 and the Nasdaq 100 before Dec. 21 if it qualifies for early inclusion. Index entry could generate billions in demand from tracking funds.

items.headline: Mirendil raises $1 billion to build AI with fewer humans
items.summary: Mirendil, a startup accelerating AI research and development, raised a $1 billion Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital. The round followed a $200 million seed just six months earlier, underscoring frantic VC deployment.

items.headline: OpenAI backs AI chip export control measures
items.summary: OpenAI joined a growing coalition supporting AI chip export legislation, adding weight to efforts to pass the measures by year's end. The move aligns a leading AI lab with Washington's national-security agenda.

items.headline: Gemini 4 Carbon now available from Google DeepMind
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model offering higher-precision knowledge work, improved agentic coding and state-of-the-art cybersecurity capabilities. It is available to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic launched two new frontier models, its first since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow AI development in September. The company said the models underwent rigorous safety testing, framing the release as 'pacing, not pausing.'
